name: Paysafe
verdict: Paysafe Limited is a NYSE-listed payments platform whose principal shareholders - funds of CVC (25.4%) and Blackstone (21.4%) and related parties - beneficially own about 54.4% of its common shares, and the filing calls it a 'Controlled Company'. Nothing found.
note: New Title Partner of Envision's Formula E team from the GEN4 era (team renamed 'Paysafe Envision' for 2026-27; announced 14 August 2026). Ownership now researched: NYSE-listed, principal shareholders CVC and Blackstone funds (about 54.4% per the FY2025 20-F); no state or state-fund holder, and no human-rights finding of the kind METHOD.md counts was located.
